name: review
description: 占位的代码 / 文档复审 atom-task。默认 enabled=false；启用后会以 sub-agent 的方式逐条核对 check-list.md，并产出 review-report.md。

prompt.instruction: Spawn a sub-agent (or treat yourself as one) and walk the check-list.md item by item. For each item, evaluate it against the produced artifacts (code in targetDir and docs in the run dir). Write review-report.md with one section per checklist item: '## <item>' followed by Verdict (pass/fail/n-a) and Notes.
guardrails: Do not edit source code in this stage; review only.
Be specific: cite file paths and line numbers when a finding is anchored.
If the checklist is empty or all items are n-a, write 'No applicable items' and continue.
